answer: Pick each grading jury at random from accounts weighted by how long they have earned honest scores, not by how many accounts someone owns. A fresh sybil swarm starts at the nadir of that weight, so its votes barely ripple through outcomes. To sway a jury, an attacker must run dozens of fakes through months of real, graded work, paying compute for every one, and a single proven collusion burns all that history like cracked onyx.
